topical JAK inhibitors and topical agents in development

notes: No exact duplicate canonical statements with the same page anchor were retained.
Distinct co-primary and secondary endpoints were retained as separate atoms.

extraction_limitations: This source is a focused review rather than a primary trial. Trial outcomes are tagged secondary_reported_result and remain anchored to the review.
The review mixed peer-reviewed articles with abstracts, meeting presentations, and industry press releases; evidence maturity varies across reported results.
ATOM extraction targeted independently reviewable, decision-relevant assertions and major quantitative trial outcomes rather than atomizing every background sentence or every cited reference.
The source reflects the therapeutic/regulatory landscape available to the authors in 2021 and should not be treated as current prescribing guidance without separate recency verification.
schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated secondary-review-summary atom kind; descriptive tags are used to preserve secondary-source status.
The quantitative-result model stores one primary estimate plus arm observations; multi-endpoint trial blocks therefore require separate atoms for independently reviewable endpoints.
